description: Curated basketball competition knowledge. Football and basketball are the two schemas this foundation completes; other sports are added later as additional catalogues behind the same loader.

espn_url.name: ESPN NBA monthly scoreboard
espn_url.coverage: NBA; one request per season month
espn_url.notes: Primary NBA historical route. Competition membership is proven from payload uids, never assumed from the requested URL.

api_basketball.name: API-Basketball
api_basketball.notes: Fallback route. Pagination metadata is a coverage unit; quota exhaustion is a distinct outcome.

competitions.name: NBA

edition_rule.label: split_year
edition_rule.window_evidence: NBA regular season plus playoffs; boundary declared in config.COMPETITION_SEASON_WINDOWS.

2019.evidence: 2019-20 season suspended 2020-03-11 and resumed in the Orlando bubble 2020-07-30; Finals ended 2020-10-11.

2020.evidence: 2020-21 season started 2020-12-22 and the Finals ended 2021-07-20.

expected_units.evidence: 2019-20 played 1059 regular-season games (COVID-interrupted); 2020-21 was a 72-game season (1080); full seasons are 30 x 82 / 2 = 1230. The 2026 edition (2026-27) is in progress and has no established total, so it is null and fails closed.

phase_classification.play_in: separate phase; never counts toward regular-season coverage
phase_classification.all_star: separate event; never counts toward regular-season coverage
phase_classification.unclassified: preserved and reported, never counted as regular season

evidence.statement: The scoreboard payload states the competition in its league uid and season type on each event.
The 2019-20 regular season was interrupted and resumed, so the season's window extends beyond June.
A full NBA regular season is 82 games per team across 30 teams.

hypotheses.statement: nba_api and sportsdataverse may supply richer NBA metadata; both are reference-only until a separate compatibility review.

known_blockers: No independently established 2026 (2026-27) regular-season total exists yet; the ongoing season must not be marked COMPLETE.
